messages:
sam_finance: Quick sync 026-10 small tiered-rate split test. Target roll 2026-10-20 07:00 UTC. Scope: new two-tier split for small/mid teams + 1% embedding rate change. Need invoice-preview and grandfathering rules.

miguel_billing: Request cohort filter (plan_ids + tag excludes). Also want to add invoice line field `tier_split_id` for easier recon.

lia_sales: Exclude negotiated and enterprise tags. I'll export AM-owned accounts and flag anyone who needs a heads-up. No surprises.

nate_ops: I'll run staging cohort query and dry-run migration. Staging SQL (run in staging):
```sql
SELECT s.id, s.customer_id, s.plan_id, c.tags
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.id = s.customer_id
WHERE s.next_billing_date BETWEEN '2026-10-20' AND '2026-11-20'
  AND c.negotiated = false
  AND c.tags NOT LIKE '%enterprise%';
```
Will upload CSV to /finance-drive.

billing-bot: invoice-preview queued for cohort tiered-split-test (sample 40).

miguel_billing: Running preview: `./tools/invoice-preview --cohort tiered-split-test --sample 40`. Link when ready.

billing-bot: invoice-preview complete  40 samples uploaded: https://redir.company/samples/tiered-split-preview.csv

miguel_billing: Preview shows 3 subs with manual rate overrides. Propose marking them `manual-exempt` and issuing one-time credits if impacted. Need sign-off on credit calc (pro-rate remainder).

sophie_legal: OK to use one-time credits for manual-exempt cases. I'll add legal-approved comms wording with explicit "no retroactive billing" line. Expect draft by Mon EOD.

sam_finance: Canary plan: 3% invoice volume 24h -> 25% days 2-4 -> full at day 7 if metrics OK. Rollback triggers: >4% revenue swing 24h or >1% billing ticket spike.

lia_sales: I'll notify AMs for flagged accounts once CSV posted. Nate, please post dry-run logs.

nate_ops: Will open PR for rate mapping (`tiered_split_v1` -> `RC_TIER_SPLIT_2026`) and run `make billing-migrate COHORT=tiered-split-test DRY_RUN=1`. Logs will be attached to PR.

sam_finance: Action items recap: Miguel exceptions sheet (due 2026-10-12), Sophie comms (due 2026-10-12 EOD), Nate PR + dry-run (due 2026-10-13). Preflight 2026-10-18. Go/no-go 2026-10-19. Thanks all.
